answer: Think of Taxi licence badge with licensing committee attestation as a toll booth: each badge is a knowledge test plus a vetted record passed by the licensing committee, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real cabbies, so the onyx of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The jetty is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The beacon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
